# Proverbs 19 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Better [is] a-poor-man walking in-his-integrity, than-one-twisted-of lips and-he [is] a-fool.

**2** Also without knowledge [the]-soul [is]-not good, and-one-hurrying [with his]-feet sins.

**3** [The]-folly-of a-man twists his-way, and-against YHWH his-heart rages.

**4** Wealth adds many friends, but-a-poor-man from-his-friend is-separated.

**5** A-witness-of falsehood will-not-go-unpunished, and-one-breathing lies will-not escape.

**6** Many entreat [the]-face-of a-noble, and-everyone [is] a-friend to-a-man-of gifts.

**7** All brothers-of a-poor-man hate-him; how-much-more his-friends go-far from-him. One-pursuing words — they [are]-not.

**8** One-acquiring heart loves his-[own]-soul; one-keeping understanding will-find good.

**9** A-witness-of falsehood will-not-go-unpunished, and-one-breathing lies will-perish.

**10** Not fitting for-a-fool [is] luxury; how-much-less for-a-servant to-rule over-princes.

**11** [The]-discretion-of a-man makes-slow his-anger, and-his-glory [is] to-pass-over a-transgression.

**12** A-growling like-a-young-lion [is the]-wrath-of a-king, but-like-dew upon grass [is] his-favor.

**13** A-ruin to-his-father [is] a-son foolish, and-a-dripping continual [is the]-contentions-of a-wife.

**14** House and-wealth [are the]-inheritance-of fathers, but-from-YHWH [is] a-wife prudent.

**15** Laziness casts into-deep-sleep, and-a-soul-of slackness will-go-hungry.

**16** One-keeping a-commandment keeps his-soul; one-despising his-ways will-die.

**17** One-showing-grace-to [the]-poor lends to-YHWH, and-his-dealing He-will-repay to-him.

**18** Discipline your-son, for there-is hope, but-to-his-dying do-not-lift your-soul.

**19** Great-of wrath bears punishment; for if you-deliver [him], still you-must-do-it-again.

**20** Hear counsel and-receive discipline, in-order-that you-will-be-wise in-your-end.

**21** Many [are the]-plans in-a-man's heart, but-[the]-counsel-of YHWH — it will-stand.

**22** [The]-desire-of a-man [is] his-lovingkindness, and-better [is] a-poor-man than-a-man-of falsehood.

**23** Fear-of YHWH [leads] to-life, and-satisfied [one]-lodges — not visited [by] evil.

**24** [The]-sluggard buries his-hand in-the-dish, and-even to his-mouth he-does-not-bring-it-back.

**25** Strike a-scoffer and-[the]-simple will-become-prudent; and-correct [the]-discerning and-he-will-understand knowledge.

**26** One-ruining a-father, one-chasing-away a-mother — a-son causing-shame and-bringing-disgrace.

**27** Cease, my-son, to-hear instruction [only] to-stray from-words-of knowledge.

**28** A-witness-of worthlessness mocks justice, and-[the]-mouth-of [the]-wicked swallows iniquity.

**29** Judgments are-prepared for-scoffers, and-blows for-[the]-back-of fools.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **19:3**: Ivvelet adam teseleph darkho — 'the folly of a man twists his way.' People ruin themselves and then blame God — a remarkable observation.

- **19:17**: Malveh YHWH chonen dal — 'lending to YHWH is one showing grace to the poor.' The metaphor of God as debtor is striking and deliberate.

- **19:21**: Atzat YHWH hi taqum — 'the counsel of YHWH, it will stand.' The emphatic pronoun hi underscores divine sovereignty over human planning.

— EMET
